identitySignals: Name matches a registered private foundation: 'Novo Foundation', Hurley, NY, EIN 47-0824753 (ProPublica Nonprofit Explorer), filing Form 990-PF through fiscal year 2024

ProPublica lists Jennifer Buffett and Peter Buffett as officers of this EIN, consistent with the NoVo Foundation they established; the foundation's website (novofoundation.org) also refers to its work in Kingston, NY, next to Hurley

NoVo Foundation's website and public pages describe funding of social and emotional learning, matching OUSD's 'Grant Award - NoVo Foundation - Social and Emotional Learning Department'; a public OUSD SEL page mentions a grant report to the NoVo Foundation
research.notes: Phone and email come from the website's structured page metadata (212.808.5400 is a New York City number; the registry address is Hurley, NY). ProPublica spells the legal name 'Novo Foundation'; the website uses 'NoVo Foundation'. No street address found. Private grantmaking foundation (990-PF filer), not a public charity.

profile.summary: A private philanthropic foundation, established in 2006, that makes grants to people and organizations. Its stated aims include supporting children's joy and curiosity and adults' health, well-being and agency. It has funded social and emotional learning programs in schools. It does not accept unsolicited funding proposals.

review.notes: novofoundation.org's structured metadata confirms legal name, 2006 founding, phone and generic info@ email, and its page confirms the mission wording and no-unsolicited-proposals policy; ProPublica confirms EIN 47-0824753, Hurley NY, 990-PF private foundation with the Buffetts as co-presidents. The SEL grant fits OUSD's 'Grant Award - NoVo Foundation - Social and Emotional Learning' item (the SEL-in-schools phrase rests on OUSD's own record, not the cited pages); the EIN's 2021 exemption date suggests a reorganized entity, but the brand, officers and mission match.
